system.name: CoServe
system.one_liner: an efficient Collaboration-of-Experts model serving system that reduces expert-switching overhead on heterogeneous CPU/GPU with limited memory

components.name: Performance Profiler
components.role: offline profiler that automatically finds optimal resource allocation and configuration for each device

components.name: Expert Model
components.role: static list of experts (<Expert 1>, <Expert 2>, ...) used to configure the system

components.name: Expert Information
components.role: static routing-rule information used to configure the system

components.name: Executor Creator
components.role: creates the inference executors using offline configuration information

components.name: Expert Initializer
components.role: loads experts into the model pool for each executor

components.name: Inference Controller
components.role: groups the request scheduler and request queues that manage incoming requests

components.name: Inference Request Scheduler
components.role: dependency-aware scheduler that assigns incoming requests to an executor and determines their execution order

components.name: Inference Request Queues
components.role: holds queued requests (e.g., Req 0-13) awaiting processing

components.name: Incoming Requests
components.role: stream of incoming inference requests entering the system

components.name: Batch Splitter
components.role: dynamically divides a batch of requests based on expert performance and available memory

components.name: Expert Manager
components.role: dependency-aware manager that loads/unloads experts in the model pool to minimize future switching

components.name: Model Pool
components.role: holds the experts currently loaded and available for inference on an executor

components.name: Expert 1
components.role: an individual expert model (depicted as a small neural network) held in the model pool

components.name: Expert 2
components.role: an individual expert model held in the model pool

components.name: Expert n
components.role: an individual expert model held in the model pool

components.name: Inference Executor 1 (GPU or CPU)
components.role: one of several stacked executors running batch splitting, expert management and inference against its model pool

flows.what: Create (loads experts into the model pool)
queued requests forwarded to the executor

content.key_idea: CoServe schedules and batches dependency-aware LLM expert-inference requests across executors, using an offline profiler to configure the system and a dependency-aware expert manager to minimize costly expert switching in a shared model pool.
content.reading_order: left-to-right through the offline profiler, system-initialization phase (executor/expert creation), then the inference controller's request scheduler/queues, into an executor's batch splitter, expert manager, and model pool

summary: Figure 7 is CoServe's architecture overview, spanning offline, system-initialization, and online phases, with an explicit legend distinguishing solid data arrows, dashed control arrows, system-module boxes, static-information boxes, and dynamic-information boxes. Offline, a Performance Profiler produces configuration (expert model list, routing rules) that flows (1) to the Executor Creator, which creates (2) an Expert Initializer that loads experts (3) into each executor's Model Pool. The same configuration also flows (4) to the Inference Request Scheduler inside the Inference Controller, which enqueues incoming requests (5) into Inference Request Queues, which feed (6) an executor's Batch Splitter. The Batch Splitter sends batched requests (7) to the Model Pool and exchanges required-experts information (7) with the Expert Manager, which manages (8) loading/unloading experts in the Model Pool to minimize future switching. Stacked panels represent multiple GPU/CPU executors, each holding several color-coded expert models.
